Item 5.02 
Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers . 
Apple Inc. (&#8220;Apple&#8221;) previously announced its Chief Executive Officer transition plan in its Current Report on Form 8-K filed on April 20, 2026 (the &#8220;Original
Form 8-K&#8221;) . This Amendment to the Original Form 8-K (the &#8220;Form 8-K/A&#8221;) is being filed to disclose John Ternus&#8217; new compensation arrangement in connection with his appointment to the role
of CEO, and Tim Cook&#8217;s new compensation arrangement in connection with his appointment to the role of Executive Chair of Apple&#8217;s Board of Directors (the &#8220;Board&#8221;), in each case effective as of September 1, 2026 (the &#8220;Transition Date&#8221;). Other than
as set forth in this Form 8-K/A, all information in the Original Form 8-K remains unchanged.
